rollups.text: Outdoor destinations and activities: the user took a five-day camping trip to Yosemite (date unspecified), hiked to the top of Vernal Falls in Yosemite (date unspecified), backpacked the Lost Coast Trail and saw migrating whales (date unspecified), and in November 2023 considered camping, hiking, and beginner snorkeling on Hawaii’s Big Island and visiting Kauai’s Na Pali Coast, including by helicopter.

Music interests: the user loves Kamasi Washington’s saxophone solos, recently discovered and enjoys Snarky Puppy’s jazz-fusion sound, loves Herbie Hancock’s music and counts Head Hunters among favorite albums, and enjoys Esperanza Spalding’s bass playing. The user has long wanted to attend Switzerland’s Montreux Jazz Festival.

Houseplants and plant-care activities: the user owns a snake plant, dracaena, prayer plant, ficus tree, peace lily, and spider plant. The user wanted to prune the leggy snake plant, uses balanced fertilizer on the snake plant and dracaena, started indoor-plant fertilizer on the prayer plant, considered a new planter for the ficus, reported some success with the peace lily, and considered propagating spider-plant babies.

The user’s reading and audiobook interests include finishing The Hate U Give by Angie Thomas shortly before a book-club meeting; enjoying The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo by Taylor Jenkins Reid, The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides, and The Nightingale by Kristin Hannah; and listening during the commute to Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari and Daisy Jones and The Six by Taylor Jenkins Reid. The user prefers immersive full-cast narration for dialogue-heavy books, but also enjoys distinctive single narrators.

rollups.text: The user’s movie and television preferences include action-packed or intense movies on weekends and lighter romantic comedies or TV series on weekdays. The user enjoys feel-good romantic comedies with witty dialogue and relatable characters, watches Netflix series and some Netflix original romantic comedies, and planned to explore Amazon Prime. The user was intrigued by The Wailing and added it to a watchlist, had been meaning to read Dune before watching its new film adaptation, and estimated watching around 12 movies in the preceding month.

Farm and animal-related items and activities: the user has a horse named Luna and a rooster named Mr. Cluckers, wanted to arrange Luna’s vet visit and vaccinations in April 2023, and asked about keeping the rooster quiet and making him a secure, predator-proof enclosure. The user bought Luna a saddle for about $500 plus a saddle pad and girth for about $100, considered the expense worthwhile for her comfort, and asked how to introduce the saddle. Luna likes sweet-potato horse treats, which the user wanted to buy in bulk.

The user’s home and personal technology includes a smart speaker used for music, reminders, and hands-free calls; a smart thermostat set up on 2023-02-10; wireless headphones bought on Amazon around 2023-03-07 at 20% off and used daily; a new internet router obtained on 2023-01-15; and cable organizers ordered online on 2023-01-28 that had not arrived by 2023-03-28. The user also needed to reorder smart-speaker batteries.

Cooking and food interests and plans: the user has taken Saturday-morning cooking classes for three months as of 2023-03-28, likes soy sauce’s umami flavor, learned to make fresh pasta and had been making it at least weekly, and wanted to apply class skills to weeknight cooking. The user planned a shrimp-and-vegetable stir-fry with soy sauce and ginger and jasmine rice, and also planned meal prep with lemon-garlic chicken, rice, and roasted vegetables, including broccoli and sweet potatoes. Other food plans included carrot-ginger soup with cream and herbs for a sick friend, and cucumber-based gazpacho and Cucumber Lime Refresher for a summer party.

The user has participated in community service by volunteering at a local food bank on 2023-03-28, sorting and packaging donations, and planned a weekend meal for a family in need on 2023-04-01–2023-04-02: pasta with tomato sauce and fresh fruit cups garnished with mint. The user also volunteered as a museum ambassador for a school field trip in early February 2023, helping at a LEGO-building station and mini-grocery store.

The user’s museum-related interests and outings include a visit with the user’s sister to the Impressionist Masters exhibition a few weeks before 2023-03-28, where they enjoyed lunch at the museum café and the user liked its quiche. The user considered renewing an expired December 2022 museum membership to visit the Modern Art Museum’s Contemporary Photography exhibit with the sister, possibly having lunch at the café, and asked about related events and the exhibit’s duration.

The user’s triathlon goal developed from considering a training program starting in May 2023 to aiming to complete a triathlon by the end of summer 2023. On 2023-03-28 the user felt nervous but excited, planned to add swimming and biking, and was practicing swimming drills at a local pool despite lacking a strong swimming background. The user used online tutorials and reading and planned to seek referrals or search for a swim coach or experienced triathlete and observe sessions. The records do not confirm whether the user enrolled or completed a triathlon.

The user’s internet service and home-network situation: on 2023-01-15 a new router substantially improved Wi-Fi signal, but the user still needed to set up its guest network. The user paid the internet bill on 2023-01-25 and intended to negotiate a better deal. By 2023-03-28, the user subscribed to XYZ Internet’s 500 Mbps plan and reported 350 Mbps download, 20 Mbps upload, and 25 ms ping; slow speeds remained a concern during work-from-home and peak family usage, despite restarting the router and finding no outage. The user planned to check plan suitability and router placement, compare providers, and consider switching, and sought tools to inspect bandwidth use. The user also had difficulty connecting a new streaming service to the smart TV and suspected the smart speaker used background bandwidth. No provider negotiation or switch is confirmed.

The user’s Napa Valley trip was planned on 2023-03-28 as a weekend celebration of the user’s sister’s engagement. The user liked a proposed itinerary and planned to book tastings and vineyard tours in advance, then said they would definitely book a private wine-blending session for the sister and her fiancé at Conn Creek Winery. The user also requested a romantic dinner recommendation after the session, but did not select a restaurant or confirm reservations. The detailed three-day itinerary and venues suggested by the assistant were not confirmed bookings.

The user exchanged phone numbers with Emily and other participants at a recent workshop by 2023-03-28 and planned to organize the contacts in a dedicated group with context notes. Emily was directing a play scheduled for April 2023. The user planned to message Emily with a professional yet friendly offer to help, and also intended to find local plays to attend.
